title: Load test procedures specified.
officialText:
Where specific load test procedures, load factors and acceptance criteria are included in the
applicable design standards listed in Chapter 35, such test procedures, load factors and acceptance criteria shall apply. In the absence
of specific test procedures, load factors or acceptance criteria, the corresponding provisions in Section 1715.3 shall apply.
